# Research Starter Lab

Learn how to start a small research project and find research programs, papers, data, and people to ask.

Public pages:
- Home: https://student-research-lab-theta.vercel.app/
- Start on your own: https://student-research-lab-theta.vercel.app/start-here
- Find a program and resources: https://student-research-lab-theta.vercel.app/resources

Program eligibility summaries link to official sources and identify the cycle used. International nationality, U.S. residence, and citizenship requirements are distinct. This directory does not indicate that applications are currently open.
